scope: Direct full-module context review; all original inventoried site start positions map to human-readable semantic contexts. T temporal/state/order, P price/priority, N declaration/other. Native AST operators/outcomes retained; no runtime proof.

A stop lower scan from max(start,range_start) inclusive to range_end exclusive. Indexed nonempty first strict hit, null authoritative; return mapped main index/open and exact time.
Nonempty unindexed lower first strict hit; no hit suppresses coarse fallback. Empty lower scans main opens at/after input start within bounds; main time used as exact fallback.
Public stop delegate. Order-backed resolver uses original first physical Order_A from supplied match, no later replacement.
Inclusive main source range, reject reversed; seed first and replace only strict improvement, earliest equal owner.
Separate inclusive source routine updates on <= bullish or >= bearish, so last equal owner. Reversed raises.
First trend confirmation STRICTLY later than Order. Native ordered confirmation list + naive exact time permits upper bound; otherwise original-order scan, no sort fallback.
Nested trend search optional bounded First indices >Order First and <=Order Break; otherwise full original order.
Skip First time/index <=Order First, Break>Order Break, First time>=Order confirmation. Require confirmation<=Order confirmation and inclusive box containment; first eligible original order wins.
Simple candidate last-equal extreme Order Break..aligned Break inclusive. Type3 owner by Reset First; missing owner/reversed Break-to-Reset range null; else last-equal extreme.
Type3 ordinary qualification exists iff first sorted trend confirmation strictly after A stop and <= crossing.
Type3 Reset interval (A stop,deadline); owner confirmation must exist and <=A stop; skip owner whose first Reset already <=A stop; resolve Break-to-Reset candidate.
Search strict lower crossing [Reset event,deadline). No hit or no trend confirmation in (A stop,crossing] rejects; no main fallback.
Build Type3 tuple with owner number and exact Reset/decision. Winner strictly earlier exact decision; equal retains first Reset traversal.

Aligned trend confirmations strictly after A stop and strictly before deadline; Break index>=A stop index. Sorted confirmation order.

Per aligned Reaction freeze last-equal extreme A-stop main..Break inclusive. Exact candidate event gated by A stop. Search begins max(confirmation,candidate event,A stop), ends min(deadline,next aligned confirmation), reject empty/reversed.

First strict lower candidate cross; skip absent or no public Blue within inclusive source-to-cross window. First qualifying returns; failed candidate replaced by next aligned Reaction. No main fallback.
Build Type4 Blue with parent A source/stop and tuple source/decision, all Order/Reset fields null, aligned number unused; no price recomputation.
Post-Order candidate main start=max(detector start,min(lower_bound(main,confirmation),First)). Anchor >=start eligible, no explicit upper-bound guard; return anchor price.

Else earliest-equal main extreme start..First. When containing confirmation main before start, scan lower remainder inclusive confirmation/exclusive main end; replace on strict improvement OR equality, assign containing main and lower price.
A exact source event first lower row within source main whose trend extreme equals price, fallback source open.
First matching S ownership interval [start,end) or open. Trigger strictly after start independently eligible; immediate false, no later overlapping-window scan.
Closed-window Reset-Reset exception requires all times nonnull, start<Blue1 source, Blue1 stop<Blue2 source, A source==Blue2 stop and both Reset. Otherwise matching window owns; no match false.
Ordinals integer−1 within Blue list, require both kinds exactly reset. Eligible A fresh sorted list excluding S ownership.
Legacy after if opposite box boundary <= A-stop low B or >=high R; before immediate. Nested aligned match preserves after.
If no nested, default exact stop to main open, compute clipped pre-Order candidate and exact event; before iff event strictly earlier than Order First main, equality after.
Initial inclusive earliest-equal main stop..Order First. Stop lower remainder [exact A stop,main end); empty returns full-main candidate.

Nonempty remainder earliest strict directional extreme; later main stop+1..First if exists wins only strictly better, ties retained by stop main. Return stop main identity with lower extreme otherwise.
Candidate exact event first equality hit in [max(source main,not_before),main end), fallback max(source,not_before), potentially after main end; public delegate.

Blue explicit formation nonnull authoritative. Non-Reset uses valid aligned trend confirmation else source open. Reset missing broken level fallback; otherwise first strict lower crossing within source main, fallback source open.
Aligned Reset Blue ordinal valid and formation<=event; no same-candle requirement. Ordinary qualifier first trend confirmation strictly after behavior start and <=event.
Candidate crossing delegates strict parent directional price; decision inputs preserve distinct gates.
Decision lower range [max(start,range_start),range_end). When any rows, opposite Order stop first strict hit across entire range independent of candidate qualification.

Candidate gate=max(scan start,candidate_start or scan start). Fallback searches without qualification. Normal chooses earliest of valid aligned Reset Blue and first trend confirmation >behavior start, candidate query starts max(gate,earliest qualifier); absent qualifier no candidate.
Fallback query starts gate. Both missing or same nonnull lower position returns null; earlier Order or sole Order returns Red mapped exact hit.
Candidate winner uses exact event; fallback upgraded Blue iff aligned Reset or ordinary trend already qualifies, otherwise stays fallback. Map owning main.

Only zero lower rows use main containing start (upper_bound−1) clamped range start through end inclusive. Candidate strict plus main timestamp>=optional candidate gate. Both main predicates =>null even if candidate unqualified; Order-only Red.
Main candidate Blue only when qualifier true; otherwise fallback if enabled, else continue. Exact event fallback equals main open.
Build Type3 Blue with supplied A and Reset owner/time, source/decision; all Order fields null.
Resolve canonical first Order stop geometry and pre/post timing. Compute pre-Order candidate only for before; initialize behavior start A stop.
Pre-order Simple exact event starts behavior; race begins Order confirmation with fallback enabled. Null returns null; non-fallback selects pre route; fallback discards decision and proceeds aligned.
Unless pre won, restore A-stop behavior start. Nested alignment yields Advanced source at opposite Order box edge main index, trend confirmation candidate gate.

Otherwise Simple requires first trend confirmation strictly after Order; last-equal extreme Order Break..aligned Break. Compute pre/red source or after-Order candidate even though non-pre final Red uses full range. Gate aligned confirmation.
If no decision run normal race; null reject. Red retains pre source only for successful pre route; otherwise earliest-equal extreme Order Break..decision main. Blue keeps chosen source.
Populate full parent A and physical Order identity, mode, box bounds and source main times, exact confirmation, stop geometry, source and exact decision. Reset fields null.
Deadline Order confirmation else range end. Evaluate both order-free routes independently; Type3 if earlier OR exact tie; else Type4; if neither then Order-backed if match, otherwise null.
Clear windows and audit then audit ALL sorted A before candidate traversal. Skip S-owned A or source<cycle start; equality also skipped when output exists.
Next A exact confirmation even if later ineligible. Find strict A stop from own confirmation inclusive; no stop skip. Compute first Order after stop before rejecting stop>=next A confirmation.
Open [A stop,null) window even if resolver null. Successful S moves cycle start to frozen source, closes window at max(A stop,decision+1us). Stable output sort source,decision.
Shared accepted Order ledger dedup by integer First/Break; skip null reaction. First entry retained unless missing stop_cross and new has nonnull stop_cross.
Require datetime confirmation; validate stop tuple length>=3 and datetime event, else recompute. Require confirmation strictly before crossing. Sort by exact cross,confirmation,First,Break.

For each S lower_bound crossing at frozen source MAIN time inclusive, only earliest candidate if cross strictly before current decision; no winner retain original. Does not separately require confirmation after S source.
Replace S color Red, Order identity/provenance and decision; retain A, frozen source/price and formation type. Clear Reset fields; no creation-cause rewrite. Input S order preserved.

Type3/4 settled through exact decision. Other types require Order and lower row at/after max(confirmation,range_start) no later than decision; otherwise no reuse. Frontier=max(decision,Order Break main,aligned Break main and confirmation if present).
Dirty index within [0,count], dirty main open or range end. Scope direction/timeframe/start/range_start; same scope rewind to earliest dependency symmetric difference, else discard prior decisions.
